description: PAM registry lifecycle commands (snapshot, validate, migrate, disable-all, purge) — pass scenarios: upgrade preserves data/config, disable-all removes every block, purge leaves no Nam-tor state

modules.registry.rs: snapshot_to/restore_from/clear/purge_file/purge_snapshot — snapshot/restore registry, purge registry file + snapshot dir
modules.editor.rs: snapshot/validate/migrate/disable_all_services/purge — lifecycle coordination (snapshot PAM+registry, validate consistency, migrate with rollback, disable-all, purge all PAM state)
modules.lib.rs: re-export ValidationStatus, ValidationReport, ValidationInconsistency, MigrationReport, snapshot, validate, migrate, disable_all_services, purge, purge_file, purge_snapshot, snapshot_dir

lifecycle_commands.snapshot: save registry + PAM files to {registry_root}/pam-snapshot/ for rollback
lifecycle_commands.validate: check registry matches PAM state (missing_block, orphaned_block)
lifecycle_commands.migrate: snapshot → re-enable all registry services → restore on failure
lifecycle_commands.disable-all: disable every registry service, clear registry
lifecycle_commands.purge: disable-all + remove backups + remove registry + remove snapshot + clean stale temps

packaging_hooks.arch: post_upgrade → migrate; pre_remove → disable-all; post_remove → purge + rm -rf /var/lib/namtor

e2e_verification.fake_root_lifecycle: enable → snapshot → validate → migrate → disable-all → purge: PASS (no namtor, no backups, no registry)
e2e_verification.failed_migration_rollback: corrupt backup → migrate fails → gdm-password block preserved → registry intact

verification.cargo_test: 19 lifecycle + 7 registry + 37 editor = 63 tests pass (0 failed)
